description.summary: Wayland protocol for associating D-Bus objects with surfaces

protocol.description:
The dbus_annotation_manager allows a client to annotate surfaces with information about associated D-Bus objects.
Clients should request the creation of an dbus_annotation object when they create a relevant D-Bus object, and should release the annotation when they destroy a D-Bus object associated with their wl_surface.
Each surface can only have one annotation with a given interface name. The already_annotated protocol error will be raised if the client requests more than one dbus_annotation object with a given interface name for a surface.

interface.name: xdg_dbus_annotation_manager_v1

description.summary: controller object for registering dbus objects associated with wl_surfaces

interface.description: An object that provides access to the creation of dbus_annotation objects.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: release the memory for the application menu manager object

request.description: Destroy the xdg_dbus_annotation_manager object. xdg_dbus_annotation objects created from this object remain valid and should be destroyed separately.

request.name: annotate_surface
request.description: Creates an annotation associated with a given wl_surface.

arg.name: interface

description.summary: identifies what kind of dbus object this is expected to be

arg.description: The interface other D-Bus clients can expect the object specified by the annotation to implement.

arg.name: surface
arg.description: The surface to associate the annotation with.

entry.name: already_annotated
entry.summary: given wl_surface already has a dbus_annotation with the same interface

interface.name: xdg_dbus_annotation_v1
interface.description:
An object that provides access to clients to notify the compositor of associated D-Bus objects for a wl_surface.
This state is double-buffered, see wl_surface.commit.
If not applicable, clients should remove this object.

request.name: set_bus

description.summary: notify the compositor of a dbus object's bus

request.description:
Set or update the bus corresponding to the D-Bus object.
If not set by the time the surface is commited the incomplete protocol error will be raised.

arg.name: bus
arg.summary: the dbus bus of a dbus object

request.name: set_bus_name

description.summary: notify the compositor of a dbus object's bus name

request.description:
Set or update the pending bus name corresponding to the D-Bus object.
Strings should be formatted according to the relevant D-Bus specifications.
If not set by the time the surface is commited the incomplete protocol error will be raised.

arg.name: bus_name
arg.summary: the dbus bus name of a dbus object

request.name: set_object_path

description.summary: notify the compositor of a dbus object's object path

request.description:
Set or update the pending object path corresponding to the D-Bus object.
Strings should be formatted according to the relevant D-Bus specifications.
If not set by the time the surface is commited the incomplete protocol error will be raised.

arg.name: object_path
arg.summary: the dbus object path of a dbus object
